Names skipped when a folder is scanned

Source: R/map_folder.R
folder_ignore.Rd

Folders and files that rarely say anything about how a project is put together, but can hold tens of thousands of files (node_modules, .git, the renv library). They are skipped during the scan, so they cost no time.

Usage

folder_ignore()

Value

A character vector. * is a wildcard, and matching ignores case.

See also

map_folder(), scan_folder()

Examples

folder_ignore()
#>  [1] "node_modules"       ".git"               ".svn"              
#>  [4] "__pycache__"        ".Rproj.user"        ".venv"             
#>  [7] "venv"               ".ipynb_checkpoints" ".DS_Store"         
#> [10] "Thumbs.db"          "desktop.ini"        ".quarto"           
#> [13] "*_cache"            "renv"               ".foldermap.json"   
#> [16] ".mappegraf.json"   
c(folder_ignore(), "output", "*.tmp")
#>  [1] "node_modules"       ".git"               ".svn"              
#>  [4] "__pycache__"        ".Rproj.user"        ".venv"             
#>  [7] "venv"               ".ipynb_checkpoints" ".DS_Store"         
#> [10] "Thumbs.db"          "desktop.ini"        ".quarto"           
#> [13] "*_cache"            "renv"               ".foldermap.json"   
#> [16] ".mappegraf.json"    "output"             "*.tmp"
